guidance.title: A starting point
guidance.intro: A brewing starting point drawn from source records, the same equipment or a similar method.
guidance.editorialNote: This is an editorial starting point, not an author instruction. Brew the source version first.
guidance.empty: There are not enough close source records to add a safe starting point.
guidance.partial: Only partly provided by the source
guidance.compareIntro: These notes are not counted in the source-parameter comparison.
guidance.equipmentEmpty: There are not enough linked recipes to offer a reference yet.

reason.sameModel: Built from records for the same model.
reason.sameEquipment: Built from {count} records using the same equipment and hot or iced mode.
reason.sameMethod: Built from {count} records using the same method and hot or iced mode.

limit.brewer: This is an equipment clue from a nearby record, not proof of what the author used.
limit.grinder: Model and setting stay in their source notation; settings are not converted between grinders.
limit.paper: This is the paper used by a reference record, not an author instruction or an official compatibility claim.
limit.temperature: Use this only as a starting point; coffee, water and technique can change the result.
limit.brewTime: Time is affected by grind, paper, dose and pouring.
